name: US Permissionless Dollar
rootCause: US Permissionless Dollar (USPD) suffered a loss of over $1 million on 4 December 2025 after an attacker exploited a race condition during proxy contract deployment, inserting a malicious 'proxy-in-the-middle' (CPIMP) backdoor. This allowed the attacker to evade detection for months before upgrading the logic contract to drain protocol collateral. The proxy contract for USPD was left uninitialized after deployment, making it possible for a third party to initialize it.
